name: TokenRadar Data Schema & Flow Coverage
title: TokenRadar Data Schema & Flow Coverage
summary: Self-contained reference for the JSON contracts and data movement used by the TokenRadar pipeline. This replaces the stale root DATA_SCHEMA.md source.
coverageUpdates: TokenMetrics now matches implementation fields, including tokenId, tokenName, symbol, riskLevel, summary, computedAt, and optional holderConcentrationEstimate.
valueVsAth is documented as the current 0-100 score used by code, not as a negative drawdown percentage.
volatilityIndex is documented as a 0-100 derived score, not as a raw coefficient such as 0.15.
The flow now includes token details, price history, TGE records, search-intent datasets, queue and quarantine paths, consolidated runtime blobs, and validation limits.

riskScore.meaning: Higher means higher risk. Inputs include volatility, market cap, volume-to-market-cap ratio, and ATH drawdown.

riskLevel.meaning: Derived from riskScore: low <= 3, medium <= 6, high > 6.

growthPotentialIndex.meaning: Composite score from distance from ATH, category-relative market cap, and recent 30-day momentum.

narrativeStrength.meaning: Category mapping score, defaulting to 30 when no mapped category is found.

valueVsAth.meaning: 100 means at ATH, 0 means nearly worthless versus ATH. This is not the raw negative ATH drawdown.

volatilityIndex.meaning: Computed from 30-day coefficient of variation and scaled with Math.min(100, volatility * 5).

notes: computedAt replaces the stale lastUpdated field from the prior docs.
Article content is consumed from content/tokens at build time and is not copied into public/content.

implemented: src/lib/schemas.ts defines Zod schemas for token metrics, generated articles, article quality snapshots, token detail data, price histories, TGE records, search-intent datasets, and search-intent history.
scripts/validate-content.ts validates JSON syntax, persisted data-schema contracts, generated article path/type/slug integrity, outbound URLs, TGE preview references, and TGE dataset invariants.
scripts/quality-check.ts enforces article quality gates such as word count, FAQ, disclaimer, data density, prohibited phrases, and readability.
src/lib/content-loader.ts validates metrics, price histories, and search-intent datasets before returning them. Invalid payloads return null instead of silently defaulting fields.
scripts/consolidate-data.ts and scripts/compute-search-intent.ts skip tokens with untrusted market data using market-data quality checks.
implementedDecisions: Invalid metric, price-history, and search-intent runtime payloads are treated as unavailable data and return null from loader APIs.
Build-time content validation fails on schema violations for the documented persisted data files.
valueVsAth is clamped to 0-100, and metric summaries interpret high scores as near ATH and low scores as deeply discounted versus ATH.
Sitemap and OG files remain build products, not data contracts, so they are intentionally excluded from this schema surface.
docs/data-schema/data-schema.json remains the machine-readable contract because the root Markdown source has been removed.
